DZA.note: No rule or authority on AI harms is stated.
The AI tools are inside the higher-education sector, not general administration.

facts.fact: The higher education minister said the 2026-2027 academic year will launch an AI-supported personal study path, with an intelligent assistant helping students choose modules, and an AI language model for lecturers is being developed to generate exercises and assess student answers.
